methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UN Press Releases is the RSS 2.0 feed of press.un.org — the UN Meetings Coverage and Press Releases service. It carries official meeting summaries, Security Council and General Assembly coverage, Secretary-General statements, senior appointments and administrative notices, spanning humanitarian, security and institutional affairs.

## Search
Client-side keyword filtering over RSS item title/description; no server query API. The feed URL is fixed and returns a single undifferentiated stream, so keyword matching (including document-symbol patterns such as SC/ or GA/) must be performed in-memory as a substring scan over each item's title and description.

## Filters
Only client-side filters are possible: publication date range (from pubDate) and keyword. Items carry no `<category>` tags and no symbol patterns (e.g. SC/12345, GA/...) in structured markup, so subject or organ filtering must be inferred client-side from the title text.

## Download
The retrievable document is the item `<link>` HTML press-release page; observed URLs end in `.doc.htm` or reference blog pages. There is no `<enclosure>` element and no direct PDF link.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Not supported.

## Limitations
Feed returns only the most recent ~10 items — a notably small window; no historical pagination and no archive parameter, so frequent polling is required to avoid missing releases.
